title: Mermaid
description: Top-level schema for a Mermaid diagram document. It gathers the cross-cutting nodes (config, directives) a `diagramType` discriminator that names which diagram body applies, and a single `body` node that holds it (flowchart first; swimlane, gantt, and the rest are added to the `diagramType` enum as they are modeled). Every node is optional. Breadcrumbs for the config node: the official config schema is https://mermaid.js.org/schemas/config.schema.json and its API docs are https://mermaid.js.org/config/schema-docs/config.html . The local `mermaidConfig-schema.json` is a copy of that official schema with every `required` array removed, because the official `required` describes the fully-resolved runtime config, not a partial author config.

config.description: Optional. The Mermaid configuration object (local copy of the official schema, with `required` removed).

diagramType.description: The diagram body type. Each value names a body schema that is generated independently in its own file. Populated with `flowchart` for now; more values are added as body types are modeled.

body.description: The body for the Mermaid diagram.
